note: Every download of the HyperFrames engine's image, pinned (package V3a-image). The values are those the S2 spike measured on 2026-11-07; `sha256_source` says where each sha256 comes from. `hf_image.py build` passes the values of the docker daemon's architecture to the Dockerfile as build arguments and refuses while a sha256 of that architecture is null. This file is in the definition, so a change to it changes the image's tag.

browser.note: Chrome for Testing publishes a size and an md5 for each archive (the official bucket's object metadata, read on 2026-10-13) and no sha256: the sha256 is computed once from a download whose size and md5 match (README.md, 'Pinning the browser for amd64'). The same pin as the ffmpeg engine's providers/renderer/browser-pin.json, kept here as a copy so that each image hashes only its own files; providers/renderer/tests/test_hf_image.py compares the two when both are in the checkout.

arm64.sha256_source: the ffmpeg engine's pin (feature/short-video), computed from a download whose size and md5 matched; the S2 build's download of 2026-11-07 matched it

amd64.sha256_source: computed on 2026-11-07 from a download whose size and md5 matched Chrome for Testing's published values

arm64.sha256_source: the value HyperFrames 0.9.19 pins in its own render image (packages/cli/src/docker/Dockerfile.render at tag v0.9.19); the S2 build's download of 2026-11-07 matched it

amd64.sha256_source: the value HyperFrames 0.9.19 pins in its own render image (packages/cli/src/docker/Dockerfile.render at tag v0.9.19); not downloaded here: the first amd64 build checks it and stops on a mismatch
